title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Cancel a Reservation
content:
Users can cancel a reservation in the CultPass app under 'My Reservations' > select the event > 'Cancel Reservation'.

- Cancellations made at least 24 hours before the event return the credit to the monthly quota
- Cancellations within 24 hours, or no-shows, consume the credit
- Support agents may cancel a reservation on the user's behalf after confirming which reservation it is

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel from 'My Reservations' in the app. If you cancel at least 24 hours in advance, the experience credit goes back to your monthly quota."

title: Refund Policy
content:
CultPass subscriptions are billed monthly in advance.

- Refunds are NOT issued automatically and require approval from a support lead
- Eligible cases: duplicate charge, charge after a confirmed cancellation, or a platform outage that prevented use
- Agents must register a refund request with the reason and escalate it to a support lead; never promise a refund amount or timeline
- Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5-10 business days

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I've registered your refund request and passed it to our billing team for review. They'll get back to you, and if approved the refund goes to your original payment method within 5-10 business days."

title: Blocked or Suspended Accounts
content:
Accounts may be blocked after suspected fraud, payment failures, or violations of the terms of use.

- Front-line agents cannot unblock accounts
- Do not disclose the internal reason for the block
- Always escalate blocked-account tickets to the Trust & Safety team
- Reassure the user that a specialist will review the case

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your account is currently restricted, so I've passed your case to our Trust & Safety team. A specialist will review it and contact you by email."
tags: blocked, suspended, account, access, escalation, security

title: Updating Payment Method and Billing Issues
content:
Users can update their card via app > 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods'.

- If a payment fails, the subscription stays active for a 3-day grace period
- After the grace period, new reservations are disabled until payment succeeds
- Invoices are available under 'My Account' > 'Billing History'
- Unrecognized or duplicate charges should be handled as a refund request

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your card under 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods'. Once the new card is saved, we'll retry the payment automatically."

title: Premium Experiences and Subscription Tiers
content:
CultPass offers two tiers: Basic and Premium.

- Basic: access to standard experiences within the monthly quota
- Premium: access to standard and premium experiences, plus early access to limited events
- Premium experiences are marked with a gold badge in the app
- Basic users can upgrade at any time via 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'; the upgrade is effective immediately

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Premium experiences are included for Premium members. If you're on Basic, you can upgrade in 'Manage Plan' and get access right away."

title: Monthly Quota and When It Resets
content:
Each subscription has a monthly quota of experiences, shown in the app under 'My Account'.

- The quota resets on the first day of each billing cycle
- Unused credits do NOT roll over to the next month
- Each active reservation consumes one credit
- Cancelling more than 24 hours in advance returns the credit

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your quota resets at the start of each billing cycle. Unused credits don't carry over, so make sure to book before the cycle ends."

title: QR Code Not Working at the Venue
content:
If a user's QR code fails at the entrance:

- Ask them to increase screen brightness and remove any screen protector glare
- Make sure the app is updated and the reservation shows status 'reserved'
- They can show the reservation ID to venue staff as a fallback
- If the venue still refuses entry, collect the venue name and time and escalate

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try turning up your screen brightness and reopening the reservation in the app. If it still doesn't scan, show the staff your reservation ID."
tags: qr code, venue, entry, attendance, technical

title: Changing Email or Personal Details
content:
Users can update their name and phone number in 'My Account' > 'Profile'.

- Email changes require verification: a confirmation link is sent to the NEW address
- Agents must not change the email on the user's behalf for security reasons
- If the user no longer has access to their old email, escalate to human support for identity verification

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can change your email in 'My Account' > 'Profile'. We'll send a confirmation link to the new address to complete the change."
tags: account, profile, email, security, personal data

title: Deleting an Account and Data Privacy
content:
Users can request account deletion under 'My Account' > 'Privacy' > 'Delete Account'.

- Active subscriptions must be cancelled first
- Data is permanently removed within 30 days, in line with LGPD/GDPR
- Users can request a copy of their data from the same screen
- Legal or data-protection complaints must be escalated to the privacy team

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can delete your account from 'My Account' > 'Privacy'. Please cancel your subscription first. Your data will be permanently removed within 30 days."
tags: privacy, delete account, data, gdpr, lgpd, legal

title: App Crashes and Technical Problems
content:
For app crashes, blank screens or loading errors:

- Ask the user to update the app to the latest version
- Force close and reopen the app; if it persists, reinstall it
- Check that the device OS is supported (iOS 15+ / Android 10+)
- If the problem persists after reinstalling, collect device model, OS version and a screenshot, then escalate to technical support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please update the CultPass app to the latest version and restart it. If the problem continues, reinstalling usually fixes it."

title: Transferring a Reservation to a Friend
content:
Reservations are personal and non-transferable.

- The name on the reservation must match the attendee's CultPass account
- To let a friend go instead, cancel the reservation and have the friend book with their own account
- Guest passes are not currently offered

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Reservations are linked to your account and can't be transferred, but your friend can book the same experience with their own CultPass account."

title: Late Arrival and No-Show Policy
content:
Users should arrive at least 15 minutes before the experience starts.

- Venues may refuse entry after the start time
- A no-show consumes the experience credit
- Three no-shows in a month may temporarily pause the ability to reserve premium events

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please arrive 15 minutes early. If you can't make it, cancel at least 24 hours before so the credit returns to your quota."

title: Event Cancelled or Venue Closed
content:
If a partner cancels an experience:

- All affected users are notified by email and push notification
- The credit is automatically returned to the user's monthly quota
- Users can rebook any available experience
- If the credit was not returned within 24 hours, an agent can check the reservation status and escalate if needed

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Sorry the event was cancelled! Your credit is returned automatically, so you can book another experience right away."

title: Contacting Human Support
content:
Human support is available Monday to Friday, 9:00-18:00 (BRT).

- Escalated tickets are answered by email within 1 business day
- Urgent safety issues at a venue should be reported to venue staff immediately
- Users can always ask the assistant to talk to a human

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I've passed your request to our support team. They're available Monday to Friday, 9:00-18:00, and will reply by email within one business day."
